recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-11202 unless a future work group issue chooses to revise Flag.code semantics beyond the published DSTU2 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-11202 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for the DSTU2 Flag resource. It asked that Flag.code support both machine processing and human readability by changing the short description from "Message to display to user" to wording consistent with the existing definition, resolved as "coded or textual message to display to user".
initial_application: The request was applied in svn-derived commit bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9, which changed the old Flag spreadsheet source Short Name for Flag.code from "Message to display to user" to "Coded or textual message to display to user". The current source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml retains that wording on Flag.code and keeps the matching definition about the coded value or textual component.
additional_context: Flag is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The source has since moved from the old spreadsheet input to source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml, but the applied wording survived that refactor. Community searches found no direct FHIR-11202 Zulip or Confluence record and no conflicting later decision; a pre-issue Zulip implementers thread confirmed the definition already directed textual flag content to Flag.code.text.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already conveys the Jira-approved machine-readable-or-textual Flag.code semantics, so no source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: The same 2016 applying commit also mentioned nearby Flag description/comment clarifications for FHIR-11203, but this audit did not decide that separate tracker.
